This page shows the relations between the Debug ROM's internal filenames for room and scene files to the actual areas in-game. When using an editor like Utility of Time, and when the area you want to view or modify isn't one of the "SPOT"s on the Map Select, you might have some problems guessing which room/scene combination is the area you need. This list was made to help with this.
